cited.quote: TANGEDCO was directed to implement a mass maintenance programme in June, 2021
Ensuring uninterrupted power supply to all categories of electricity consumers in the State is the foremost objective of this Government

rationale: C1 reports a mass maintenance programme and plans to add capacity ('will be added'); C2 states an objective and plans. No extract shows an order scaling up generation and distribution capacity on a wartime basis. Not started.

cited.quote: A total of 17,980 MW of power generation capacity will be added through own generating stations in the next 10 years.
As on date, 5 projects in Chengalrayan, Vellore, Cheyyar, Arignar Anna and Perambalur sugar mills have been commissioned

rationale: C1 only plans new capacity and investments. C2's sugar-mill co-generation projects were already exporting power in 2020-21, before this government, and are not shown as new commissioning for uninterrupted supply. No new generation or distribution project commissioned by this government is shown.

cited.quote: This Government will call upon the Government of India to constitute a National
Commission for the Welfare of Fishermen to look into all aspects relating to the welfare of marine and inland fishermen.

rationale: C3 and C1 (Governor's Address) state the government will call upon the Union to constitute the commission: a statement of intent. No Assembly resolution, Chief Minister's letter or GO urging it is shown. Not started.
C1-C5 are health insurance hospital empanelment lists and orders; none is about establishing advanced speciality hospitals in Kovai, Nellai, Trichy or Krishnagiri.

cited.quote: This Government will urge the Government of India to remove the income criteria for determining the creamy layer

rationale: C1 concerns OBC reservation advocacy (creamy layer), a statement of intent, not urging 27% reservation in IIT admissions and teacher appointments. C2-C5 concern state reservations. No formal advocacy step on this issue. Not started.

cited.quote: the Hon’ble Chief Minister has appointed a Special Officer to resolve all the grievance petitions received during the programme
all the 4,57,645 petitions received under the programme have been acted upon

rationale: C1 reports a Special Officer appointed to resolve all petitions within 100 days (step reported by 21 June 2021, the only date given). C2 reports all 4,57,645 petitions acted upon and the 100-day commitment implemented. Exact appointment date not shown.

cited.quote: It will be ensured that all courts have adequate buildings in the next five years.

rationale: C2 is a budget statement on court buildings generally; nothing on office rooms for lawyers in district courts. Other extracts are unrelated. Not started.

cited.quote: this Government will focus its attention to make agricultural graduates as entrepreneurs

rationale: C1 (agriculture budget speech) announces a scheme to make graduates agri-entrepreneurs ('will be implemented'): a budget announcement, not an operational incentive. No GO shown. Not started.

cited.quote: approve the Guidelines as annexed to this order for Implementation of Namakku Naame Thittam (Urban)
This Government will re-launch the Anna Marumalarchi Thittam with an outlay of Rs.1,200 crore during 2021-22.

rationale: C1 is the GO (13.09.2021) issuing guidelines to implement Namakku Naame Thittam (Urban). Anna Marumalarchi appears only as a budget announcement (C2), with no GO. One scheme operationalised, the other not.

cited.quote: Action will be taken to procure these protein rich pulses through Co-operative Societies and Tamil Nadu Civil Supplies Corporation
permit the sale of Palm Jaggery through select Fair Price Shops run by Cooperatives

rationale: C5 is a budget statement on procuring pulses through cooperatives for the Noon Meal scheme: a mention, not a measure. C2 permits sale of palm jaggery to cardholders through fair price shops, not procurement for mid-day meals, hostels or messes. Not started.
C1-C5 cover Tamil computing, general school education and professional-course reservation; none is about linguistic minority students learning their mother tongue in schools.
C1-C5 concern e-services, the Governor's Address on housing and urban works, vaccination protocol, pensions and urban infrastructure; none is about senior citizen centres in district headquarters.
C1-C5 cover economic advisory council, democracy statements, higher education, State Development Policy Council and tourism committee; none is about reconstituting the Legislative Council.
C1-C5 concern relief for Covid-orphaned children, outsourced health workers and bonded labour SOP; none is about compassionate appointment for children of sanitary workers.

cited.quote: This year 10 new Government Arts and Science Colleges will be commenced.

rationale: C1 discusses higher education expansion (new colleges, plans) but nothing on new universities in Kanchipuram or Erode. C2-C4 are hospital lists; C5 is a turmeric research centre in Erode. No step for the universities. Not started.
C1-C5 concern e-services, urban employment scheme guidelines and a health outreach scheme; none is about senior citizen centres with NGOs or altruistic institutions.

cited.quote: permit the sale of Palm Jaggery through select Fair Price Shops run by Cooperatives
arrange to supply good quality Palm Jaggery to the District Consumer Cooperative Wholesale Stores / Agricultural Producers Cooperative Marketing

rationale: C1/C3 are the GO of 30.09.2021: cooperatives (incl. Agricultural Producers Cooperative Marketing Societies) obtain palm jaggery by indent from the Khadi and Village Industries Board for sale on pilot basis. Procurement by cooperatives exists but via KVIB, not directly, and only as a pilot. Real doubt whether this counts.
C1-C5 concern muscular dystrophy allowance, Covid-orphan relief, pensioners' and employees' family security funds; none is about the lawyers' welfare fund.
C1-C5 are Covid treatment, triage and lockdown orders; none is about 24-hour flood control centres during the rainy season.

cited.quote: This Government will expedite the special programme for diversification of fishing trawlers from the Palk Bay area

rationale: C5 covers fisheries budget plans (trawler diversification, harbours, relief) but not loans or subsidies to fishermen cooperative societies for boats, nets or search lights. C3 covers inland pisciculture subsidy. No step for the commitment. Not started.
